note: Wayback replay (only the 2 BBC feeds). Spain high-speed train crash, 68 dead, BBC lead; GDACS cyclone ARNAB (India) with no news.

blurbs.text: At least 68 people are killed in a collision between two high-speed trains in Toledo, Spain.
Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (pictured) is re-elected President of Brazil.
In the Serbian parliamentary election, the Student List wins a majority of seats, defeating former president Aleksandar Vučić and his Serbian Progressive Party.
In Jordan, a mass shooting at a church leaves nine people dead.
